title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 204
paragraphs: This army of the Persians reached Euesperides, and this was their furthest point in Libya. The Barcaeans whom they had reduced to slavery they removed from Egypt and brought to the king, and King Darius gave them a village in the land of Bactria to make a settlement in. They gave this village the name of Barca, and it was still inhabited by them in my own time, in the land of Bactria.
